newsitem.title: HUNGARY: ALLIANZ BECOMES SOLE OWNER OF HUNGARIA RT.
newsitem.headline: ALLIANZ BECOMES SOLE OWNER OF HUNGARIA RT.

text.p: Germany's Allianz AG Holding boosted its stake in Hungaria Biztosito Rt, one of Hungary's largest insurance companies, to 100 percent from 90.7 percent, Hungaria said on Thursday.
"Allianz has used its preemption right," Hungaria's deputy managing director Karoly Salamon told Reuters.
Allianz bought a stake of some nine percent in Hungaria from the state privatisation agency APV Rt.

Salamon said Hungaria plans to increase its revenue to over 49 billion forints this year from 41 billion forints in 1995, and forecasts to boost its consolidated after-tax profits to three billion forints from 1.5 billion forints last year.
Hungaria has used its recent profits to write off losses it posted in the early 90's, but its books still include a loss of over 10 billion forints, which has not been written off, he added.
Allianz purchased 49 percent of Hungaria in 1992, and it has increased its stake gradually since then.
